build_xml_dataset: build a huggingface dataset from XML files using the Xml ArrowBasedBuilder class
configure_xml_loader: configure the XmlConfig dataclass with custom features encoding and encoding_errors options
generate_xml_tables: generate PyArrow tables from XML files by reading content and casting to schema
cast_xml_table: cast a PyArrow table to match the configured features schema or default xml string schema
split_xml_generators: split XML data files into dataset splits using the dl_manager download and extract
